Showing results for dov bed instead' with exactly 1 irrelevant result (a bed Sheet Set under category 'Sheets') - confirms the search index itself has zero dog/pet bed products, corroborating rather than contradicting the other findings (this is the false-absence pattern the brief warns about, but here every independent check - nav tree, sitemap, category page rendering, PDP breadcrumbs, and search - agrees on absence, so it is treated as genuine absence, not assumed from search alone). Conclusion: no Pet Care rows emitted. No qty was fabricated anywhere in this investigation.
